text:
maria_cs: FYI — Aurelia Fin sent back their SIG/CAIQ + a bespoke security questionnaire. They flagged two high-priority asks: 1) formal proof of KMS/HSM usage and key rotation policy, 2) audit log retention windows + example proof exports. They also reported an intermittent 401 on our API and a billing spike last Thursday. Need owners; customer deadline EOD Tue.
olivia_support: Thanks Maria. I already pulled the billing spike — looks like a retry storm from their webhook consumer between 2026-03-05 03:12-03:24 UTC. Charge IDs: ch_1A2b3C... I can send the CSV.
evan_se: For the 401s, can you grab one request_id/trace_id? Also did they use API key or token exchange? 401 could be expired token if using delegated keys.
maria_cs: @evan_se request_id=rt_20260305_9f3b; they said it happened across a couple of endpoints (chat/completions and embeddings). I'll paste the customer repro snippet.
maria_cs: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-ctl","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```
rahul_eng: That curl looks fine. From the trace id I see a 401 returned by the auth service, not the runtime. @james_sec can you check the token introspection logs for that time? Could be a short-lived token that wasn't refreshed.
james_sec: Checking now. For rt_20260305_9f3b I see an `invalid_signature` from our token verifier at 03:12:43 UTC — token header alg mismatch. Could be a client library bug or bad secret rotation on their side. However, we should also produce an audit artifact for them showing auth decision logs.
maria_cs: Customer specifically wants: 1) KMS/HSM attestation (vendor + whether keys are in HSM, rotation cadence, ops contact), 2) sample audit log export showing records for a sample API key and key usage, 3) confirmation on retention policy (default 90 days) and options for longer retention. They called out evidence for last 12 months for compliance.
audit-bot: exported audit slice -> s3://redwood-evidence/aurelia/2026-03-05-auth-logs.csv (access: redwood-sec+aurelia@company). Generated 2026-03-06T08:15:00Z.
james_sec: I can prepare a short attestation doc: "Redwood uses AWS KMS with an HSM-backed CMK provided by AWS CloudHSM for dedicated private deployments; key material is stored in HSM and we maintain a 90-day automatic rotation window for ephemeral customer keys; customer-managed CMKs are supported via Bring-Your-Own-KMS (BYOK)." Need legal signoff for formal wording. Who owns: @maria_cs to coordinate.
olivia_support: I uploaded the billing CSV and trace export to the shared folder: https://drive.company/reports/aurelia-2026-03-05.zip
rahul_eng: For the audit log proof we should include a snippet mapping: timestamp, request_id, api_key_id, action, decision. I can pull a redacted CSV that matches their sample. Will avoid PII.
maria_cs: Action items: @james_sec prepare attestation draft + recommended wording for HSM proof; @rahul_eng prepare redacted audit export mapping to the request_id we gave; @olivia_support send billing CSV and explanation; @evan_se confirm root cause of 401 (client token vs our rotation). Deadline: EOD Tue (2026-03-10) to send to customer. Pls update this thread when done.
evan_se: Quick update — I repro'd a token failure using their SDK v0.9.2: it sets alg=HS256 in header while our verifier expects RS256 for service tokens. I've opened a ticket against their SDK provider and sent them a workaround (use server-token or update SDK). Marking customer issue as "client-side token formatting" for now.
james_sec: Draft attestation attached (in thread folder). Wording provisional: "Redwood Inference — KMS/HSM statement: production keys for hosted customers are managed in AWS KMS with HSM protection; enterprise/private deployments may use customer-managed HSMs; audit logs are retained 90 days by default; extended retention can be provided under contract." Sending to legal now.
maria_cs: Great. @rahul_eng can you include a few lines showing sample audit records for rt_20260305_9f3b? Customer asked for a redacted export that still shows api_key_id mapping.
rahul_eng: Yep. Pushed redacted CSV to s3://redwood-evidence/aurelia/redacted-auth-2026-03-05.csv. Noting: kept api_key_id hashed; included request_id, time, action, decision. Shared ACLs updated.
olivia_support: Billing note for customer: spike due to retries from their worker — we can credit the duplicated requests; I'll start the credit request and include guidance on exponential backoff. Will CC account manager.
maria_cs: We're close. Two blockers: legal signoff on attestation wording, and a quick note confirming retention policy for private deployments (customer asked about >1 year). @james_sec can you escalate to compliance? They need formal retention SLAs.
james_sec: Escalating to compliance now. If customer needs >1 year, we require a contract amendment; we can offer archive export for long-term retention as a stopgap.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll reply to Aurelia with a summary and attach the redacted CSV + billing explanation. Will note the attestation is pending legal signoff and retention beyond 90 days requires contract. :white_check_mark:
olivia_support: Follow-up: credit request submitted (CR-7782). ETA 3 business days. Also added recommended webhook retry settings to the ticket.
maria_cs: Closing loop later today after legal signs off. If anyone has additional artifacts, drop them here. :pray:
